cohort: 140 pregnant women with severe preeclampsia (blood pressure >= 160/110 mmHg with proteinuria or blood pressure >= 140/90 mmHg with proteinuria >= 2+).
finding: Mean arterial pressure >126 mmHg, uric acid >7mg/dl, platelet count <100,000 cells/cc, and serum creatinine >1.2 mg/dl were significantly correlated with poor maternal outcome in women with severe preeclampsia.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight (specific values not provided)
